# Lines for Life

> > Oregon's leading nonprofit dedicated to preventing substance abuse and suicide through crisis intervention, education, and advocacy.

Lines for Life operates the 988 Oregon crisis line and partners with the Oregon Health Authority, Oregon Legislature, and tribal communities including Multnomah, Kathlamet, Clackamas, Chinook, Tualitin Kalapuya, and Mollala. The organization hosts the annual Oregon Conference on Opioid + Other Drugs, Pain, and Addiction Treatment (OPAT) and works closely with the Oregon Partnership and American Association of Suicidology.
